title: You Think Your Body Borders Are Fixed, Yet Two Paintbrushes Move Your Hand in Seconds
description:
You think your brain permanently knows where your body ends! Yet two simple paintbrushes can relocate your hand fast! This is the true story of Botvinick's Rubber Hand Illusion. Here is what went wrong with fixed body myths.
